data.title: France's Macron to visit Marseille after protest violence
data.description: MARSEILLE (FRANCE) - The French government sought to draw a line Monday under weeks of protests that have been marred by violence, with President Emmanuel Macron headed to Marseille and the prime minister to meet with students demanding better school conditions.

data.title: Bang Na land prices jump 39% as east Bangkok growth accelerates
data.description: Land prices in Bang Na and nearby eastern Bangkok districts rose 39% year on year, leading gains across Bangkok and surrounding provinces in Q3 2026.

data.title: Expanded solar for households scheme for cabinet approval Tuesday
data.description: The government’s proposed 50,000 baht subsidy to encourage up to one million households to install a solar power system will be presented to the cabinet on Tuesday for approval.

data.title: Poster of fake B7m transfer slip to Anutin identified
data.description: Authorities have identified the person behind a fake transaction slip purporting to show a 7-million-baht transfer to Deputy Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul. The image circulated online before the government, police and bank involved investigated and debunked the claim on Monday.

data.title: Three tonnes of African elephant tusks seized in Thai port
data.description: CHON BURI - Customs officials seized about three tonnes of elephant tusks smuggled from Africa found hidden inside timber consignments in two shipping containers at Laem Chabang port.

data.title: 15 trees felled at Rama 9 memorial in Chiang Mai park
data.description: The National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation Department will take legal action against at least seven people for cutting down 15 trees, including 11 wild Himalayan cherry trees, at a memorial built to honour the late King Bhumibol Adulyadej in Chiang Mai province.

data.title: Bumrungrad Introduces Comprehensive Care Model for Alzheimer’s Patients
data.description: Bumrungrad International Hospital champions a holistic approach to Alzheimer’s care in response to Thailand’s aging society, integrating expertise in neurology, geriatric psychiatry, geriatrics, and clinical nutrition. The approach covers the full continuum of care, from diagnosis and treatment to long-term care. Advances in biomarkers and Amyloid PET scans help improve diagnostic accuracy, while anti-amyloid medications offer a treatment option for selected patients in the early stages of the disease. These advances are complemented by personalized care that aims to preserve patients’ ability to function independently and maintain their quality of life for as long as possible.

data.title: Chiefs and 49ers suffer first losses of NFL season, Vikings stay unbeaten
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - The Seattle Seahawks put on a defensive masterclass to hand the Kansas City Chiefs their first defeat of the NFL season on Sunday, winning 20-3, while the San Francisco 49ers also surrendered their perfect start to the Atlanta Falcons.

data.title: Thailand, UNESCO Join Forces at AFE 2026 for Equitable Education
data.description: 23 October 2026 – The Equitable Education Fund (EEF) Thailand and the UNESCO Regional Office in Bangkok and Office for UN Coordination for Asia and the Pacific (UNESCO Bangkok), under the Equitable Education Alliance (EEA) framework, co-organised the 4th International Conference on Equitable Education , also known as the All for Education Conference 2026 (AFE 2026), from 23–24 October 2026 at IMPACT Forum, Nonthaburi, Thailand. Under the theme “Designing Tomorrow’s Equity: Equitable Solutions for Out-of-School Children and Youth by 2030 and Beyond,” the Conference focused on developing solutions for out-of-school children and youth to make education systems more equitable, inclusive, and flexible.
